blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Coast Guard District (CGD) of Palawan on Thursday, Nov. 12, continued the temporary suspension of sea travel for small vessels due to rough sea conditions. In an advisory, the CGD-Palawan said vessels or watercraft with a gross tonnage (GT) of 15 and below were prohibited from sailing in the following areas: READ: PCG suspends sea travel in Palawan due to rough seas Coast Guard Station (CGS) North Eastern Palawan CGS South Western Palawan Meanwhile, vessels and watercraft 3GT and below were also barred from sailing within the areas as follows: CGS Southern Palawan CGS South Central Palawan […]...
